findings.summary: Connections policy Apply action does not call the typed bulk policy mutation.
findings.details: The task packet requires admins to bulk-select joined channels and set explicit routing/delivery policies. The current web surface builds a request-shaped object, then only displays local readiness text, so no policy epoch/delivery generation can be created from the UI and the task's control-plane acceptance path remains incomplete.
